ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT ("Agreement") made as of the I day of August, 2013 by and between 155 EAST 49"h STREET CORPORATION, a New York corporation with an address at 155 East 49"h Street, New York, having an address at 805 Third Avenue, 7th Floor, New York, New York 10022 ("151 Developer") and EXG 138E50 LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 805 Third Avenue, 7"h Floor, New York, New York 10022 ("138 Developer", together with 151 Developer"Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by the street addresses as 153-155 East 49'h Street, designated as Lot 29 in Block 1304 on the Tax Map of the City, County and State of New York, as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and. made a part hereof (such land being herein called the “Owner Land,”" said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Owner Building,” and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, (a) 138 Developer is the owner in fee of 138 East 50th Street, New York, New York, (Block 1304, Lot 45) and (b) 151 Developer is the owner in fee of 151 East 49th Street, New York, New York (Block 1304, Lot 28) (the “Lot 28 Land") as such premises are more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto ((a) and (b) above being collectively called, the “Developer Land"), the building and improvements thereon are herein referred to as the “Existing Developer Building.” WHEREAS, Developer presently intends to demolish the Existing Developer Building and to construct a new building on a development site which will include Developer Land and/or any Additional Parcels (as hereinafter defined) and to construct other improvements associated with such new building (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building"; the Developer Land and any Additional Parcels on which the Developer Building will be constructed, hereinafter, collectively, the “Development Site"; and the Developer Land and the Developer Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Parcel"); Combined Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined), utilize, other Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) or Additional Parcels, and (B) merge the Combined Zoning Lot with Additional Parcels to create an enlarged Combined Zoning Lot; WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant NYDOCS03/949687.13
